dex.entry: A towering eclipse-spirit whose crescent core is now fully ringed by a disc of null-dark; it embodies the omen of a total eclipse — foreboding, still, and able to drain conviction from anyone who meets its gaze. The crescent grew into an eclipse — the omen of everything going still before something

art.silhouette: Tall spectral silhouette, a full solar-eclipse disc at the chest (silver rim, ink-dark centre), long ink-mist arms reaching wide, crescent crown of pale fire atop the head; dramatic and eerie at 64px.
art.palette: Tall spectral silhouette, a full solar-eclipse disc at the chest (silver rim, ink-dark centre), long ink-mist arms reaching wide, crescent crown of pale fire atop the head; dramatic and eerie at 64px.
art.direction: The crescent grew into an eclipse — the omen of everything going still before something terrible or wonderful happens.
